summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K containing a Regulatory News Service announcement dated 31 July 2026 regarding total voting rights and capital. The filing reports 58,146,487,315 ordinary shares of 10p each with voting rights, including shares represented by American Depositary Receipts, and no treasury shares. The figure is provided for shareholders to use as the denominator for FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules notifications. This is a routine disclosure of share counts, not a special-situation transaction, so it does not qualify under any special-situations category.
